visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a green short-sleeved t-shirt and black athletic shorts leans forward against a white kitchen island, intently reading a white sheet of paper. Behind him, a woman in a grey long-sleeved shirt and pink-and-white checkered pajama pants stands still with her hands covering her face in a crying gesture. The setting is a bright, modern indoor kitchen with white walls and a crystal chandelier. (2) The woman suddenly breaks her pose and sprints towards the man. She executes a high spinning kick, first knocking the paper out of the man's hands and then striking him in the upper body. The man loses his balance and falls backward onto the wooden floor as the paper flutters into the air. (3) The man sits on the floor looking stunned and rubbing the side of his face. The woman turns her back and walks briskly away from the camera, moving toward a hallway on the right side of the frame. (4) The man stands up slowly, looking toward the hallway as the woman enters a room and forcefully slams a white door shut. The man remains by the counter, holding his jaw and looking bewildered as the scene ends.
